description: Prepare a decision review: returns the record and history with its latest two inspections (older ones are counted), any operative accepted revision, provenance, changes, and source, diff and commit previews since the latest valid inspection for both sets of anchors, and a reviewToken. For accepted-guidance inspection use inspectionScope operative on both prepare and inspect; pending proposals remain unassessed. Default all scope covers both revisions. After source inspection, record inspect with inspector, note and token to report no contradiction found without human acceptance. For human review, prepare with all scope, then record accept, reaffirm, or retire with its token, the authorized reviewer, and a reason. Acceptance replaces the operative revision; retirement withdraws the entire record including its proposal. Acceptance requires owner, source, readable Git HEAD, and committed anchor changes. Changed records or code invalidate the token. Identities and approvals are recorded assertions for normal PR review, not authenticated proof.

action.description: Prepare is read-only. Inspect records an agent assessment without approval; accept, reaffirm and retire require an authorized review.

diffFrom.description: For prepare only: lastReview previews changes since the latest inspection still valid for this record and scope (default); capture previews the full history since the evidence baseline.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

id.description: Decision id from get_context or save_decision

inspectionScope.description: For prepare/inspect only: all covers the full record and both anchor sets (default); operative covers only an active accepted revision, leaving a pending draft unassessed. Use the same scope when submitting its token.

inspector.description: Actual agent or person performing inspection; required for inspect. Does not claim human approval.

note.description: Review rationale; required for a verdict. Cite evidence for the decision.

reviewToken.description: Token from the prepared review; rejects stale record or code revisions

reviewer.description: Identity of the actual reviewer; required for a verdict. Never invent one.

name: review_decision
